# Source notes

The adapter uses the publicly documented Transformers and Accelerate APIs.

- https://huggingface.co/docs/accelerate/usage_guides/big_modeling
- https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main_classes/model
- https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp

Checkpoint identity, representation, and configured context must be preserved. A successful transport check is not evidence of numerical inference.
